title: ntopng Flow Summary Failure Rate
dataSources: UniFi controller events (`unifi:event`), Pi-hole query log (`pihole:query`), AdGuard Home (`adguard:query`), speedtest-cli results (`speedtest:result`), router/firewall syslog, ISP uptime probes.
app: UniFi / router syslog, Pi-hole/AdGuard, and scheduled speedtests via HEC scripted inputs and the Universal Forwarder.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ntopng:flow
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(flow_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by host_name
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often ntopng flow summary records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each host.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize flow_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per host.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It catches which parts of your ntopng flow summary data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
